conflicts.problem: The lessons give three incompatible capacities for the same conical sisal cover and drum. Lesson 1 gives cone ≈3.1 L and cylinder ≈9.4 L. Lesson 2 gives the cone (r = 21 cm, h = 42 cm) as ≈19.4 L, so the matching cylinder would be about 58 L. Lesson 4 gives cone ≈6.16 L and cylinder ≈18.47 L. No Final Explanation can agree with all three sets of figures.
For r = 21 cm and h = 42 cm, V = ⅓π(441)(42) = 6174π ≈ 19 396 cm³, not 19 373 cm³. The stated figure is a small arithmetic error.

Lesson 4 defines R as the top radius and r as the bottom radius of the bucket, and says the large cone's tip is removed from the bottom. Lesson 8 says the frustum 'keeps a wide bottom (radius R)' and narrows to r. The lessons disagree on which end of the bucket is wide.
